response.sql: WITH order_invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), total_invoices AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count FROM order_invoice_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT oic.order_id, oic.invoice_count, CAST(oic.invoice_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / NULLIF(CAST(ti.total_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)), 0) AS share FROM order_invoice_counts oic CROSS JOIN total_invoices ti), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM with_shares), above_average AS (SELECT ws.invoice_count, ws.share, ws.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM with_shares ws CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE ws.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess FROM above_average;
